action: lodge an application with a notified body of its choice containing the provider identity, a written declaration that the same application has not been lodged with any other notified body and the technical documentation referred to in Annex IV, supply further evidence or carry out further tests where the notified body requires, and inform the notified body of any intended change to the AI system or of changes it becomes aware of
object: technical documentation of the AI system
mechanism: application, further evidence and information on changes
conditions: the AI system covered by the quality management system under point 3
validity_note: Norm applicable at the declared reference point; see W_DECLARATION temporal_reference
support_gap_report: Material establishment of the depended-on positions/devices is not assessed (layer X not collected from legal text); documented/legal-constitution status only
evidence_span: an application with a notified body of their choice shall be lodged by the provider for the assessment of the technical documentation

type_note: examination of the technical documentation, certification or refusal and assessment of changes
textual_direction: notified body -> provider (examination of the technical documentation; certificate or refusal with reasons; assessment of changes and supplement)
action: examine the technical documentation, require further evidence or tests and carry out adequate tests itself where not satisfied, notify the decision to the provider or its authorised representative with conclusions and reasoned assessment decision, issue a Union technical documentation assessment certificate where the system conforms or refuse it with detailed reasons (with specific considerations on training data quality where the data requirement is not met), and assess intended changes, deciding whether a new conformity assessment under Article 43(4) is required or a supplement to the certificate can be issued
object: technical documentation and conformity of the AI system with Section 2
mechanism: examination, certification or refusal and assessment of changes
conditions: where the AI system is in conformity with the requirements of Chapter III Section 2 the certificate indicates the provider, the conclusions of the examination, the conditions of validity and the data for identification; supplement where changes are approved
validity_note: Norm applicable at the declared reference point; see W_DECLARATION temporal_reference
authority_attribute: decision to issue or refuse the Union technical documentation assessment certificate
support_gap_report: Material establishment of the depended-on positions/devices is not assessed (layer X not collected from legal text); documented/legal-constitution status only
evidence_span: The technical documentation shall be examined by the notified body

type_note: access of the notified body to data sets and, under conditions, trained models; the access is an entitlement of the notified body
textual_direction: provider -> notified body (access to training, validation and testing data sets and, upon a reasoned request, to the training and trained models including relevant parameters)
action: grant the notified body full access to the training, validation and testing data sets, including through APIs or other remote access, and, after all other reasonable means to verify conformity are exhausted and proven insufficient and upon a reasoned request, access to the training and trained models of the AI system including relevant parameters
object: data sets and trained models of the high-risk AI system
mechanism: access to data sets and trained models
conditions: where relevant and limited to what is necessary to fulfil its tasks, subject to security safeguards; access to trained models only where necessary to assess conformity, after other reasonable means are exhausted and upon a reasoned request; subject to existing Union law on the protection of intellectual property and trade secrets
validity_note: Norm applicable at the declared reference point; see W_DECLARATION temporal_reference
authority_attribute: access to data sets and trained models for conformity assessment
support_gap_report: Material establishment of the depended-on positions/devices is not assessed (layer X not collected from legal text); documented/legal-constitution status only
evidence_span: the notified body shall be granted full access to the training, validation, and testing data sets used

type_note: surveillance of the approved quality management system
textual_direction: notified body -> provider (surveillance: periodic audits, audit report and additional tests)
action: carry out periodic audits to make sure that the provider maintains and applies the quality management system, provide the provider with an audit report and carry out additional tests of the AI systems for which a Union technical documentation assessment certificate was issued
object: compliance of the provider with the approved quality management system
mechanism: periodic audits, audit report and additional tests
conditions: additional tests may be carried out in the context of the audits
validity_note: Norm applicable at the declared reference point; see W_DECLARATION temporal_reference
authority_attribute: audit and testing powers over the approved quality management system
support_gap_report: Material establishment of the depended-on positions/devices is not assessed (layer X not collected from legal text); documented/legal-constitution status only
evidence_span: The notified body shall carry out periodic audits to make sure that the provider maintains and applies the quality management system

type_note: access to premises and information for surveillance; the access is an entitlement of the notified body
textual_direction: provider -> notified body (access to the premises where design, development and testing take place; sharing of all necessary information)
action: allow the notified body to access the premises where the design, development and testing of the AI systems is taking place and share with the notified body all necessary information
object: premises and information relevant to surveillance of the quality management system
mechanism: access to premises and sharing of information
conditions: for assessment purposes
validity_note: Norm applicable at the declared reference point; see W_DECLARATION temporal_reference
authority_attribute: access to premises and information
support_gap_report: Material establishment of the depended-on positions/devices is not assessed (layer X not collected from legal text); documented/legal-constitution status only
evidence_span: the provider shall allow the notified body to access the premises where the design, development, testing of the AI systems is taking place
